paite: Huan, ginnaa hatlou mi, a ngaihdante gense louin ngai un.
english: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

paite: Mi khatin thil bangkim ne thei din a kigingtaa mi hatlou inbel antelouhing kia a ne hi.
english: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

paite: Bangkim neten a neloute simmoh kei henla; nelouten leng a nete gense kei heh; Pathianin amah a kipahpih khin ngala.
english: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

paite: Mi dang sikha gensepa kua na hia? a din leh a puk amah toupa ading ahi. Himahleh, amah jaw dinsakin a om ding, Toupan a dingsak thei ngala.
english: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

paite: Mi khatin ni khat ni dang sangin a sep thupi tuama, mi dangin ni tengteng kibang chiatin a sep. Mi chih amah lungsim ah kitheichian heh aw.
english: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

paite: Ni tangpan Toupa pahtawina dingin a tang ahi. Huan, bangkim nepan, Pathian kiangah kipahthu a gen jiakin, Toupa pahtawina dingin a nea; a neloupan leng Pathian kiangah kipahthu a gena, Toupa pahtawina dingin a ne kei a ahi.
english: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

paite: Kuamah eimah adia hing i hi kei ua, kuamah eimah adia si leng i hi sam kei hi.
english: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

paite: I hin leh, Toupa adingin i hinga; i sihin leng Toupa adia si ihi ngala: huaijiakin, i hin inleng, i sihin leng Toupaa i hi uhi.
english: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

paite: Kris sihna leh honghinnawnna pen tuh, mi hing leh misi Toupa a hih theihna ding ahi ngala.
english: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

paite: Himahleh nang bang achia na unau gensia na hia oi? Ahihkeileh, nang bang achia na unau simmoh na hia oi? Pathian thukhenna tutphah maah i vek un i ding ding ua.
english: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

paite: Toupan, mi tengteng ka maah a kun ding ua, lei tengteng leng Pathian kiangah a kipulak ding uh, chiin, ka chiam ahi, achia, chih gelh ahi ngala.
english: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’” Isaiah 45:23

paite: Huchiin, i vek un Pathian kiangah eimah tanchin i gen chiat ding uh ahi.
english: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

paite: Huaijiakin, kigense nawn kei ni, kuapeuhin a unau lampi ah kisuihna hiam dalna hiam koih louh tum jaw hen.
english: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.

paite: Amah mawngmawng ah sianglou bangmah himhim a om kei chih Toupa Jesu ah ka thei mahmah ahi; bangkhat siangloua sehpen bel, aseppa adingin a sianglou ahi hi.
english: I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

paite: Na bangkhat nek jiaka na unau lungsim a nat leh, itna danin na gamta kei ahi. A sih sik Kris in a sih sakpa tuh na bangkhat nekin hihmang kei hen;
english: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

paite: Huchiin, nou adia hoihna gilou lama genin om kei hen.
english: Then don’t let your good be slandered,

paite: Pathian gam tuh nek leh dawn lam thu ahi ngal keia, diktatna khawng, kituahna khawng, Kha Siangthoua kipahna khawng ahi jaw hi.
english: for the Kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

paite: Kuapeuh huai thu ah Kris nasem tuh Pathian kipahpih leh, mihing phatin a om nak ahi.
english: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

paite: Huchiin, kituahna ding leh, kihihhat tuahna ding thilte i delh ding uh.
english: So then, let us follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

paite: Na bangkhat nek jiakin Pathian nasep hihse ken. Thil tengteng a siangthou ngei a, himahleh a bangkhat nekin mi a hihpuk leh a nepa adingin gilou ahi.
english: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

paite: Na unau pukna ding a hih leh, sa nek louhte, uain dawn louhte, thil bangpeuh hih louh a hoih ahi.
english: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

paite: Ginna na neih Pathian maah nangmah kia theihin nei maiin. Amah hoih sak lama siamlouh kitangsak lou tuh a hampha hi.Ahihhangin, ginglelpan a nek leh, ginnaa a nek louh jiakin, siamlouh a tang ahi; bangpeuh ginna loua hih jaw khelhna ahi ngala.
english: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.

paite: Ahihhangin, ginglelpan a nek leh, ginnaa a nek louh jiakin, siamlouh a tang ahi; bangpeuh ginna loua hih jaw khelhna ahi ngala.
english: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
Now to him who is able to establish you according to my Good News and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which has been kept secret through long ages,
but now is revealed, and by the Scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, is made known for obedience of faith to all the nations;
to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever! Amen. TR places verses 24-26 after Romans 16:24 as verses 25-27.
